system_prompt: You are a concise assistant. Use the tools when they help. Keep answers short.

get_weather.description: Current temperature in Celsius for a city.

multiply.description: Multiply two numbers and return the product.

get_stock.description: Latest stock price for a ticker symbol.

scenarios.prompt: In one sentence, what is the capital of France?
What is the weather in Lisbon right now?
Get the weather for Lisbon, Oslo and Tokyo, then name the warmest city.
Look up the populations of Lisbon and Oslo, then use the multiply tool to multiply them. Reply with only the product as digits.
Extract the person from this text: 'Maria Silva, 34, moved to Porto last spring.'
What is the stock price of ACME? If the tool fails, reply with the word UNAVAILABLE.
